places: Australia Day (commemorates the arrival of the First Fleet of Australian settlers)

fields.climate: generally arid to semiarid; temperate in south and east; tropical in north
fields.terrain: mostly low plateau with deserts; fertile plain in southeast
fields.hazards: cyclones along the coast; severe droughts; forest fires; volcanism: volcanic activity on Heard and McDonald Islands
fields.resources: alumina, coal, iron ore, copper, lithium, tin, gold, silver, uranium, nickel, tungsten, rare earth elements, mineral sands, lead, zinc, diamonds, opals, natural gas, petroleum
fields.farm: wheat, sugarcane, barley, rapeseed, milk, cotton, sorghum, beef, lentils, grapes
fields.exports: iron ore, coal, natural gas, gold, minerals
fields.industries: mining, industrial and transportation equipment, food processing, chemicals, steel
fields.languages: English 72%, Mandarin 2.7%, Arabic 1.4%, Vietnamese 1.3%, Cantonese 1.2%, other 15.7%, unspecified 5.7%
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 20%, Protestant 18.1% (Anglican 9.8%, Uniting Church 2.6%, Presbyterian and Reformed 1.6%, Baptist 1.4%, Pentecostal 1%, other Protestant 1.7%), other Christian 3.5%, Muslim 3.2%…

system.text: federal parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm

fields.legal: common law system based on the English model
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory

holiday.name: Australia Day (commemorates the arrival of the First Fleet of Australian settlers)

fields.military: 17 years of age (with parental consent; 18 years of age to deploy) for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription (abolished 1972)
